target_customer: Knowledge workers and teams who want an AI desktop agent that works on local files with their choice of model provider
problem: Closed agent apps such as Claude Cowork lock users to one model vendor and keep files and setups in the vendor's cloud; teams want an open, shareable setup of skills, MCPs and agents.
business_model: Free open source desktop app with paid add-ons (MCP Gateway, AI Gateway, Cloud App) and a Team plan listed at 10 USD per user per month
product_category: Open source AI agent desktop app, developer and enterprise tooling

founders.name: Ben Shafii
founders.background_notes: YC page lists no background. An aggregator places him in Berlin, which conflicts with the YC listing of San Francisco.

competitors.name: Claude Cowork (Anthropic)
competitors.what: Closed desktop agent that runs on Claude models only

competitors.name: Eigent
competitors.what: Open source multi-agent AI coworker app

competitors.name: Rowboat
competitors.what: Local first open source AI coworker with a knowledge graph, Apache-2.0

technical_complexity.rationale: A desktop wrapper over the OpenCode agent runtime with MCP and skills management, cross platform packaging and gateways; standard engineering with some hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Open source code is copyable and many alternatives exist; community size and shared team setups are the main stickiness.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Vendors shipped their own agent desktop apps in 2026; no direct action against OpenWork is known.

market_need_then: Interest in Claude Cowork and complaints about vendor lock-in drove demand for open, model agnostic alternatives; the Show HN post and fast GitHub growth in 2026 show developer pull.

branding.domain_note: Company site is openworklabs.com, not openwork.com; several unrelated companies are named Openwork.

identity.logo: An openwork-mark SVG; design not described in sources
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and confident, focused on user control and sovereign AI

branding.brand_signature: The open source alternative to Claude Cowork
branding.community_and_virality: Show HN launch in January 2026; reviews report roughly 14k to 18.5k GitHub stars and 150k to 200k downloads (self reported or press); a reported licensing controversy about possible relicensing.

brand_strength.rationale: Strong developer awareness from GitHub and Hacker News, and a clear positioning line, offset by a generic, collision prone name.

outcome_analysis: OpenWork is an Active Spring 2026 company with strong early open source traction, reported by its YC launch post as 14k GitHub stars and over 150k downloads within three months. It rides the shift to agent desktop apps, but faces vendor-built rivals and a licensing trust question. No acquisition or shutdown news was found.
notes: Aggregators (VCBacked, FundedIQ) report a 500k USD pre-seed in June 2026 with Y Combinator and Rebel Fund; only aggregator sources, so unverified and not recorded as a round. Company is operated as Different AI, also called Openwork Labs. Competitor source dates are approximate to 2026. Completeness pass: one round recorded (pre-seed, 500K USD, June 2026) resting on aggregators only (VCBacked, FundedIQ); a cross-check search found the VCBacked listing naming YC and Rebel Fund without a visible round size, and no press confirmation.
